M-FLEXVERSE-ROOT.Purpose: Unity runtime host: the global FlexVerseRoot MonoBehaviour owning the registry and updater, created by the mod entry point and configured from mod settings.

Scope.SCP-IN-001: FlexVerseRoot: root object lifecycle, per-frame update pumping.
Scope.SCP-IN-003: Shared generated texture cache teardown on root destruction.
Scope.SCP-OUT-001: Registry/updater mechanics — owned by M-BEHAVIOR-REGISTRY and M-BEHAVIOR-UPDATER.

Requirements.REQ-001: Exactly one root exists per session per SS-RUNTIME-SERVICES.REQ-001.
Requirements.REQ-002: The root survives RimWorld scene loads without duplicating.
Requirements.REQ-003: OnDestroy clears shared AppearanceMasks and GradientTextures caches only for the live root instance, not on individual Widget unmount.

Inputs.IN-001: Unity frame callbacks (Update) on the root object.

Outputs.OUT-001: static accessor to the live root and its services.

SideEffects.EFF-001: Creates a persistent GameObject in the Unity scene.
SideEffects.EFF-002: Destroys shared appearance and gradient textures during framework teardown.
